lore.amendments.dragon_charge: A fiery charge that bursts into a lingering cloud of flame.
lore.amendments.dye_bottle: Made by using a Glass Bottle on a cauldron of dyed water, keeping whatever shade the dyes were mixed to. Craft it with a dyeable item like leather armour, or a coloured block, to tint it that exact colour, or pour it back into a cauldron.
